description: Places text, a picture or a clip on the video for chosen seconds, in a box (x, y its centre; width, height; fractions of the frame), with an optional animation. overlay_id replaces that overlay. Cost: Free: no credits.

align.description: kind text: alignment in the box.

animation.description: How it arrives and leaves; none (a cut) when left out.

asset_id.description: kind image or video: an asset_id from import_media or list_assets.

base_version.description: The version_id you read; refused if the video changed since.

font.description: kind text: the face; Inter-Medium when left out.

font_size.description: kind text: letter height as a fraction of the frame; 0.05 when left out.

more.description: More overlays in the same save, each with the fields above.

operation_id.description: A retry with the same id runs once.

output_id.description: An output (Short, hook, shape); the main video when left out.

overlay_id.description: The ov_ id to replace; left out, the same look is the same one.

source_in.description: kind video: the clip second it starts from.

name: put_overlay

outputSchema.description: Clypmint put_overlay result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Add or replace an overlay
